conclusion: The apparent OOS edge was almost entirely generated by treating next-bar entries already beyond the predefined ORB-extreme stop as immediate profitable stop exits. After rejecting or clipping these impossible fills, the residual strategy has no positive OOS expectancy. Same-bar ambiguity and target-inset sensitivity do not explain the artifact.
